doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Data: Flame Step is itself the attack ('dash attack in facing direction'); footage 0372-0377: crouch, ~0.3s drive, ~0.35s low recovery, no slash inside it. Ours: a slash pressed in the crouch or the drive swings as the drive ends.

rmb.source: Data: no rule for RMB inside Flame Step (the patch only restricts turning after RMB into Shift); footage: no RMB inside a dash. Ours: the Smash starts mid-dash (the Slam's wind-up, the Lunge's charge) and the drive carries him into it.

e.source: Data: the chain is a thrown hook with no movement lock; footage 0301-0366 shows no dash with it. Ours: the throw goes mid-dash, the drive goes on.

x.source: Data: Volcanic Rebuke makes him Invulnerable, then he strikes back; footage ult f33-f38: planted through the guard; the sheet's combo is 'dive with Quick Dash, then the guard'. Ours: X ends the dash (or its crouch) and he plants into the guard.

q.source: No source (the glove is ours). Ours: as every hero's default, it goes mid-dash.

lmb.source: No source: the footage shows no air dash (he uses the Air Slam in the air). Ours: as on the ground, the slash swings at the end.

rmb.source: Data: Obsidian Slam is the RMB 'while airborne', with its own slot; footage 0251-0300: the slam from the air onto a cursor disc. Ours: RMB in the air dash ends it and the Meteor Drop's hang begins at once.

e.source: No source for the air dash. Ours: the throw goes mid-dash.

x.source: Data and footage: the guard is planted (ult f33-f38). Ours: X ends the air dash and the guard goes up.

lmb.source: No source. Ours: Shift drops a Searing Wave charge (a slash's swing is too short to matter).

rmb.source: Data: 'turning restricted after RMB into Shift' (patch 05.02.25): the dash comes after the strike, facing its way. Ours: Shift during the Slam's wind-up, a Lunge or a Meteor Drop is held and goes the moment it's over (the Meteor Drop lets it go 0.25s into its recovery); the turn lock is not built.

e.source: Owner: 'you can cancel or exit per the source'; the source's exit is not shown in the data or footage. Ours: Shift in the Warchain's pull ends it and the Rampage drives at once (no crouch), the pull's speed running into it; while the chain only flies or holds, the dash just goes.

x.source: Data: invulnerable, then the strike; footage ult f33-f44: planted ~1.1s, the cleave, the recovery. Ours: the guard and cleave are committed; Shift is held and goes when it's over.

ground.source: No source (into_dash.lmb). Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): the Rampage drops a Searing Wave charge with nothing swung.

air.source: No source. Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): the air dash drops a Searing Wave charge with nothing swung.

x.source: Data and footage: the guard is planted (ult f33-f38). Ours today (measured by --dash-flow-check): no jump during the guard and the cleave (JuggernautUlt holds him down).
